updates.text: A safety board notification confirms Zenith PowerStation does not hold an UL 2743 safety certificate.

policies.text: Consumer hardware achieves premium warranty coverage when maintaining an IP68 ingress protection score.
Fleet vehicles receive municipal transport authorization when equipped with a zero-emission drivetrain designation.
Machinery obtains high-capacity field work clearance provided its maximum lifting capacity reaches 40 metric tons.

An item achieves standard merchant listing when meeting battery capacity of at least 1,000 Wh, inverter output rating of 1,500 W, surge protection rating of 3,000 W, and an UL 2743 safety certificate, or by holding an EU EcoDesign compliance certificate.
An appliance obtains eco incentive funding if it possesses an Energy Star rating.
Supply purchasing authorization is granted for any item maintaining valid merchant listing status.
